text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The panel's composition tells you almost nothing here. You and the successful candidate are both women, so sex can't easily explain why she was chosen over you — and an all-female panel picking a woman over another woman isn't a pattern that points anywhere. Raising it would likely read as grasping, and could cost you credibility on the point that actually matters.

The more plausible questions are whether "excellent client relationships" was weighted over technical depth, and whether age played a part (you're in your forties; eight years' experience suggests a younger appointee). That's a different claim, needing different evidence.

Chase the written explanation: polite follow-up to HR, citing your original request date.
